title:
Janda Haven.
Premium Hospitality.
content: A premium bed and breakfast booking platform that captures warmth and elegance while making it effortless for guests to explore rooms, view amenities, and book their stay. Built with modern web technologies for performance and SEO.
challenge: Needed a modern online presence that could showcase accommodation, improve trust, and simplify customer inquiries.
solution: Designed and developed a responsive website with modern branding, optimized user experience, and mobile-first performance.

title:
Enterprise DMS.
Document Intelligence.
content: A centralized document management system with secure storage, versioning, real-time collaboration, notifications, role-based permissions, and internal chat. Built for organizations that handle sensitive documents daily.
challenge: Organizations struggle with document storage, version control, approvals, collaboration, and communication.
solution: Developed a centralized DMS with secure storage, versioning, real-time collaboration, notifications, role-based permissions, and internal chat.

title:
HR Platform.
Workforce Intelligence.
content: An integrated HR management platform featuring biometric attendance, employee records, payroll preparation, leave management, reporting, and analytics. Built to replace manual HR processes with intelligent automation.
challenge: Manual attendance tracking and HR workflows caused inefficiencies, errors, and wasted hours.
solution: Integrated biometric attendance devices with an HR management platform featuring employee records, attendance, payroll, leave management, and analytics.

title:
VT Ads Flow.
Visa & Travel.
content: A modern visa and travel agency platform that streamlines the entire travel experience. From visa application tracking to flight bookings and travel packages, the site delivers a seamless, user-friendly journey.
challenge: Travel agency needed a modern platform to manage visa applications, bookings, and customer communications.
solution: Built a comprehensive travel platform with visa tracking, booking management, and customer portal.
